class.name: CameraFeed
class.brief_description: A camera feed gives you access to a single physical camera attached to your device.
class.description: A camera feed gives you access to a single physical camera attached to your device. When enabled, Godot will start capturing frames from the camera which can then be used. See also [CameraServer]. [b]Note:[/b] Many cameras will return YCbCr images which are split into two textures and need to be combined in a shader. Godot does this automatically for you if you set the environment to show the camera image in the background.

method.name: capture_image
method.description: Returns an independent RGBA snapshot of the latest completed frame. The feed must be active and have published at least one frame. Returns an empty reference when CPU capture is unavailable.

method.name: get_calibration
method.description: Returns the calibration profile for the active capture format. When supported, the dictionary contains [code]valid[/code], [code]reference_size[/code], [code]size[/code], [code]focal_length[/code], [code]principal_point[/code], [code]radial_distortion[/code], [code]tangential_distortion[/code], [code]camera_to_device_rotation[/code], and [code]camera_to_device_translation[/code]. An empty dictionary means calibration is unavailable.

method.name: get_diagnostics
method.description: Returns backend diagnostics when available. The Vita backend reports captured, published, and dropped frame counters; frame age and format; YUV publication timing; and on-demand RGBA conversion timing.

method.name: get_formats
method.description: Returns the capture formats supported by this feed. Each entry is a dictionary containing [code]size[/code] and [code]fps[/code], and may include a backend-specific [code]native_format[/code]. An empty array means format selection is unavailable.

method.name: get_latest_frame
method.description: Returns an independent snapshot of the latest completed frame, including its metadata. Returns an empty reference when no frame is available or the requested format is unsupported. A backend using a native YUV stream may perform an on-demand conversion when [constant FRAME_RGBA] is requested.

method.name: set_capture_format
method.description: Selects a capture format returned by [method get_formats]. The feed must be inactive.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the unique ID for this feed.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the position of camera on the device.
